findings.detail: A07 observed pct_sum is 0.0%, but the source industry-classification percentage schedule totals 100.00%.

rationale: This is a Class 3 aggregate flag with no row coordinates. The raw filing has an industry-classification percentage schedule for September 30, 2025 split across tables 73 and 74; the terminal source row is table 74 row 30, 'Total | 100.00 %'. The oracle artifact reports A07 pct_sum=0.0%, so the extracted/checked value disagrees with the schedule total rather than reflecting the source.
